curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Cast out at birth and hunted by a shadowy priest, can Dar harness the wilderness in time to confront the forces that destroyed his family?
curatedMovie.description: Exiled as a royal infant and raised in secret, Dar sees his adoptive father slain by marauders, prompting him to unlock an uncanny bond with wild beasts and set out on a perilous path of revenge.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting 1980s fantasy adventure with medium-paced quest momentum and moderate suspense, great for group viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Don Coscarelli, this 1982 fantasy adventure channels classic sword-and-sorcery energy through high-stakes creature action and a steady, mythic quest.
